inputs.name: CatalogRepository.constructor.db
inputs.description: The synchronous SQLite connection that all catalog reads and writes go through. The constructor uses it at once to create the tables when initialize is true and to read catalog_metadata, so a connection that cannot run those statements makes construction throw.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.constructor.initialize
inputs.description: When true, the constructor creates the catalog tables, checks them, and then creates the query indexes; when false, it creates nothing and only checks the existing tables and the schema version.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.replace.index
inputs.description: The complete history index to store, with its branches and every revision with the records and coverage that the index lists for it. Every catalog table is emptied before the write, so a revision left out of this index is removed from the query index.

revisions.subject: Keep unavailable registries out of the catalog
revisions.author: Tomas Berger
gaps: no verification record is attached to this commit

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.replace.snapshots
inputs.description: One snapshot per commit, pairing the commit hash with that revision's RevisionRegistry; each snapshot's units are stored as entities of its commit, and each revision takes its registry availability and scenarios from the snapshot with the same commit. A revision with no matching snapshot is stored with no registry and no scenarios.

registry.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.entities.options
inputs.description: Filters and paging for the entities query: commit selects the revision (the catalog head when omitted), kind must match exactly, and search is a case-insensitive substring of the unit's title or unit id. limit defaults to 100 and must be an integer from 1 to 10000, and offset defaults to 0 and must be a non-negative integer.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.dependencies.unitId
inputs.description: The unit id whose dependencies are listed, such as 'repository.catalog'. It must match a stored unit id exactly, and an id that the revision does not contain returns an empty list rather than an error.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.dependencies.commit
inputs.description: The commit whose recorded dependency graph is read, as a commit hash. When omitted or empty, the catalog head is used: the head of the main branch (or of the first branch by id when there is no main branch), or the newest stored revision when no such head exists.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.consumers.unitId
inputs.description: The unit id whose consumers are listed, such as 'service.catalog-write'. It must match a stored unit id exactly, and an id that no dependency in the revision targets returns an empty list rather than an error.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.consumers.commit
inputs.description: The commit whose recorded dependency graph is searched for consumers, as a commit hash. When omitted or empty, the catalog head is used: the head of the main branch (or of the first branch by id when there is no main branch), or the newest stored revision when no such head exists.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.history.unitId
inputs.description: The unit id whose history is listed, such as 'repository.catalog'. It must match a stored unit id exactly, and the result holds every stored revision that contains the unit, or an empty list when none does.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.records.commit
inputs.description: The commit whose attached verification records are listed, as a commit hash. When omitted or empty, the catalog head is used: the head of the main branch (or of the first branch by id when there is no main branch), or the newest stored revision when no such head exists.

inputs.name: CatalogRepository.scenarios.commit
inputs.description: The commit whose declared scenarios are listed, as a commit hash. When omitted or empty, the catalog head is used: the head of the main branch (or of the first branch by id when there is no main branch), or the newest stored revision when no such head exists.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.replace
outputs.description: The value undefined: the call returns only after the whole query index has been replaced in one transaction. If a write fails, that transaction is rolled back to its savepoint and the error is rethrown.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.entities
outputs.description: The unit records of the requested revision that match the query, ordered by title and then unit id, each exactly as its registry stored it. The array holds at most limit entries and is empty when no unit matches or the revision stores no units.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.dependencies
outputs.description: The units that the requested unit depends on in the requested revision, ordered by unit id and then via; unit is the dependency's unit id and via is its edge kind, such as 'import'. The array is empty when the unit has no dependencies in that revision.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.consumers
outputs.description: The units in the requested revision that depend on the requested unit, ordered by unit id and then via; unit is the dependent's unit id and via is the edge kind, such as 'import'. The array is empty when no unit in that revision depends on it.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.history
outputs.description: Every stored revision that contains the requested unit, newest first by committed time, each as the history index recorded it, with its commit, coverage, gaps, records and detail path. The array is empty when no stored revision contains the unit.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.records
outputs.description: The verification records attached to the requested commit, each as the index lists it, ordered by record id. Each id is the record's sha256 hex digest, and the array is empty when the commit has no attached records or is not stored.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.scenarios
outputs.description: The scenarios declared in the requested revision's registry, ordered by scenario id, each with its units, states, viewports, tests and evidence. The array is empty when the revision declares no scenarios or is not stored.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by the constructor with 'Unsupported SQLite catalog schema version' when the catalog_metadata row 'catalog' has a schema_version other than 1, and by entities with 'Invalid catalog pagination' when limit or offset is out of range. The constructor also propagates the SQLite adapter's assertModels errors, such as 'SQLite model columns do not match table: <table>', when the stored tables and their models disagree.

outputs.name: CatalogRepository.constructor
outputs.description: The new CatalogRepository instance; its readonly adapter property is the SqliteAdapter built over the given connection and the catalog models.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown with 'Unsupported SQLite catalog schema version' when the catalog_metadata row 'catalog' has a schema_version other than 1, whichever value initialize has.
